ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there is a rectangle PQRS, with four congruent circles arranged horizontally inside the rectangle, adjacent circles tangent to each other, and each circle tangent to the upper and lower sides of the rectangle. Point T is on the upper side and is the point of tangency of the second circle with the upper side; point U is on the lower side and is the point of tangency of the third circle with the lower side; R is the lower-right corner of the rectangle. In the figure, R, U, and T are connected to form triangle RUT. Reasoning: The radius of each circle is 6 cm, so the diameter is 12 cm. Let S=(0,0), and let the base SR be a horizontal line; then the height of the rectangle is 12, and after the four circles are placed side by side, the width of the rectangle is 4×12=48, so R=(48,0). The x-coordinates of the centers of the four circles are respectively 6,18,30,42, and the y-coordinates are all 6. Therefore the upper point of tangency of the second circle is T=(18,12), and the lower point of tangency of the third circle is U=(30,0). The base RU of triangle RUT lies on the bottom side, with length 48−30=18; the height from T to the base is 12. Area = 1/2 × 18 × 12 = 108.

method.method_draft: Use coordinates. From the image, the four congruent circles are arranged horizontally inside rectangle PQRS, each tangent to the top and bottom sides, and adjacent circles are tangent. Read T as the top tangency point of the second circle, U as the bottom tangency point of the third circle, and R as the lower-right corner. From the text, each radius is 6, so each diameter is 12. Set S=(0,0), bottom side horizontal, so the circle centers are at x=6,18,30,42 and y=6. Then T=(18,12), U=(30,0), and R=(48,0). Triangle RUT has horizontal base RU=48-30=18 and vertical height from T to the bottom side equal to 12. Compute area = (1/2)(18)(12)=108.
